title: Telemetry Reliability Lab
body: Find where signals are lost. Verify what survives.
label: Python · Gradio · OpenTelemetry

title: Acceptance is one boundary
body: SDK buffers, queue admission, retry limits, collector crashes, and backend indexing each affect delivery. A success response upstream does not establish an end-to-end result.
label: The problem

title: Two execution paths
body:
WorkloadGateway → scheduler → worker. Traces, logs, and metrics.
CollectorBatches, export queues, retries, and optional persistent storage.
BackendsPrometheus metrics. Loki logs. Jaeger traces.
Run evidenceIsolated probes and a fault relay record admission, loss, and recovery.
label: Architecture

title: A controlled failure, a measured result
body: Each experiment stores its hypothesis, signal identities, queue observations, backend queries, and assertions. A fresh recovery canary distinguishes backend health from recovery of the original backlog.
label: Evidence model

title: Persistent storage has limits
body: The recorded persistent crash recovered 12/12 traces and 12/12 logs. Memory-only crash and retry exhaustion recovered 0/12 originals of each signal; new canaries arrived. Saturation recovered the 4/12 signals admitted per queue.
label: Recorded observations

title: Nine tested boundaries
body: Baseline delivery · Cardinality growth · Instrumentation gate · Slow worker · Backend outage · Persistent crash · In-memory crash · Retry exhaustion · Queue saturation
label: Coverage

title: Scaling requires more than queue size
body: Measure ingress, backlog bytes, export capacity, delivery delay, and disk behavior. Separate failure domains. Add durable job ownership, authenticated access, and durable signal backends for shared operation.
label: Design considerations

title: Inspectable infrastructure engineering
body: The repository includes Python source, configuration, tests, and recorded evidence. Synthetic CPU work and bounded failures establish specific behavior; they do not establish GPU performance, production adoption, or exactly-once delivery.
label: Scope
